candidates.change_summary: Replace return of storage variable `_owner` with `address(0)` so that owner always returns the zero address regardless of actual ownership.
Replace return of storage variable `_owner` with `_msgSender()` so that owner returns the caller's address instead of the stored owner.
Replace return of storage variable `_owner` with `address(this)` so that owner returns the contract's own address.
Delete the require statement that prevents transferring ownership to the zero address.
Replace require condition to always succeed, allowing transfer to zero address.
Replace require condition to check newOwner != address(this) instead of newOwner != address(0), allowing zero address transfers.
Replace _transferOwnership call with a call to renounceOwnership, effectively renouncing ownership instead of transferring.
Replace _transferOwnership call with a call to transferOwnership(msg.sender), causing an infinite recursive loop that will revert due to gas.
Replace _transferOwnership call with _transferOwnership(address(0)), always transferring ownership to the zero address.
Replace require condition in onlyOwner modifier to always revert, making transferOwnership impossible.
Replace require condition in onlyOwner modifier to check msg.sender != address(0), allowing any non-zero address to call transferOwnership.
Delete the entire body of _checkOwner, removing the onlyOwner restriction entirely so anyone can call transferOwnership.
Move the onlyOwner modifier from transferOwnership to renounceOwnership, removing the owner-only restriction on transferOwnership.
